package planted

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"syscall"
)

func leak() {
	fmt.Println("one")
	fmt.Printf("%s\n", "two")
	fmt.Print("three")
	println("four")
	print("five")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(6)
	cmd := exec.Command("true")
	cmd.Stdout = os.Stdout
	_, _ = os.Stdout.Write([]byte("seven"))
	f := os.NewFile(1, "stdout")
	_ = f
	_, _ = syscall.Write(syscall.Stdout, []byte("eight"))
	fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "allowed: stderr")
}
